final_message:
Yen receipts now show `Paid ¥500 by card` instead of `¥5.00`. All 18 tests pass, including the yen receipt test.

The bug was in `formatMoney` in `src/utils/money.js`. It divided every amount by 100, but yen has no minor unit. I added a small zero-decimal currency set (just `JPY`) that skips the division and decimals.

`formatMoney` is shared, so cart totals and invoice lines now show yen correctly too. Nothing else in the repo uses `JPY`, so no other output changes.
